summary: Possible 6th-great-grandfather of John (father of Samuel Pringle) - a lead only.
bio: The Prindle Genealogy (1906, p.41) confirms James Prindle b. 1736, m. 'Anar' Turner, d. Newtown 1800, and a 'James Jr.' in 1771, but lists no children. FamilySearch assigns him children James (c1754), David (1757), Benjamin (1764), Samuel (c1767) and Hannah (1773) - exactly the Orange Co. sibling set plus militia private Benjamin. Note a James Jr. c.1754 predates the 1759 marriage.
openQuestions: Newtown CT probate of James Prindle (d. 1800).
